post.caption: In 1893 the County of Lincoln gave Princess Mary a diamond brooch as a wedding gift. In 1932 a flexible diamond band of eleven sections was made for Queen Mary, with a place for the brooch. Queen Elizabeth lent the bandeau to Meghan Markle, who wore it at her wedding on May 19, 2018, and her first public display was at Windsor Castle later that year.
